facts.blocked_reason: Concurrent private and community rooms with two distinct owners, overlapping active-room intervals, and distinct settlement receipts (74368 and 19520 msat) are observed, but provider-generation isolation is not preserved: the harness asserts identity distinctness only within one scenario and strips every generation digest from the public receipt, so no cross-room comparison survives, and the receipt's identityIsolationObserved field is a hard-coded harness literal rather than a measurement. Community Sarah's tool-free capability profile is a source contract plus a source-text assertion, not an observed refusal: no private editor fact and no privileged tool was requested in a live community room and refused.
not_observed: distinct_provider_generations: a preserved comparison showing the concurrent private and community generations differ
context_isolated: a live observation, as opposed to the generation unit tests
capability_isolated: a live observation, as opposed to the capability-profile contract and its source-text test
private_fact_refused: community Sarah asked for a private editor fact and refusing it
privileged_tool_refused: community Sarah asked for a privileged tool and refusing it
facts.note: This receipt records what was actually observed for one Sarah LiveKit release-gate row on Omega v0.2.0-rc29. It never promotes source tests, configuration, deployment-lifecycle receipts, or a headless harness run into an installed packaged-candidate observation.
refused_claims: Distinct settlement digests prove billing isolation only; they are not promoted into provider-generation isolation.
A tool-free capability profile that structurally exposes no tools is an architectural argument, not an observed refusal, and is not recorded as private_fact_refused or privileged_tool_refused.

source_evidence.role: read-only production acceptance audit; records the connectivity, load, privacy, cost, and drill rows as blocked or not run

facts.unblocks_when: A concurrent run preserves the private and community generation identifiers so they can be compared, and a live community room requests a known private editor fact and a privileged tool and preserves both refusals.
